report:
In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The patellofemoral joint, there is focal  high grade chondrosis (more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) with subchondral edema and intact2 cyst at medial patellar facet (about 2.5*1.2 cm). The trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 In the intercondylar notch, there is suspected chronic partial tear with mature scarring of the posterior cruciate ligament. The anterior cruciate ligaments are intact.  
 The medial and lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 No knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is no fracture or bone contusion.   -- Focal  high grade chondrosis with subchondral edema and intact2 cyst at medial patellar facet (about 2.5*1.2 cm).

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Four-week history of knee pain localized to the anterior and medial aspect of the knee after twisting and hyperextension injury.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Scattered areas of full-thickness fissuring along the lateral patellar facet with mild subchondral marrow edema, low-grade cartilage loss about the median ridge and medial patellar facet. The trochlear cartilage remains intact.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 12 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Mild edema involving superolateral Hoffa's fat, may reflect underlying impingement.
2.	Mild patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.

Interprétation : 
Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire. Pas de kyste de Baker significatif avec un liséré de liquide au sein du récessus poplité. 
En corrélation avec les radiographies du genou droit, suspicion d’un ossicule méniscal au sein de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne mesurant 7-8mm de diamètre avec déchirure radiaire transfixiante à la jonction de la corne postérieure et de la racine postérieure de même qu’au niveau de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne avec extrusion significative du corps méniscal de façon associée. Ceci est nouveau dans l’intervalle. Stabilité d’une déchirure longitudinale horizontale centrée au corps du ménisque interne s’étendant légèrement aux cornes postérieures et antérieures et à la surface articulaire inférieure. 
Également dans l’intervalle, il y a progression significative des changements dégénératifs au compartiment fémoro-tibial interne avec perte transfixiante des surfaces chondrales, principalement aux surfaces portantes et changements sous-chondraux réactionnels associés. Ostéophytes marginaux modérés. 
Le ligament collatéral interne est intact sans déchirure. 
Légers changements de signal au sein de la corne antérieure du ménisque externe suggérant des changements de nature mucoïde dégénératifs. Pas de franche déchirure notée. 
Changements dégénératifs légers à modérés au compartiment fémoro-tibial externe avec atténuation/fissure chondrale partielle à la surface portante et petits ostéophytes marginaux associés. 
Le complexe ligamentaire collatéral externe est intact sans déchirure. 
Les ligaments croisés antérieur et postérieur sont intacts sans déchirure. Petit kyste intra-osseux réactionnel sous l’insertion distale du ligament croisé postérieur. 
L’alignement patellofémoral est préservé. Changements dégénératifs modérés à sévères au compartiment patellofémoral, plus marqués le long de la facette patellaire externe et apex patellaire avec fissures chondrales transfixiantes et changements sous-chondraux réactionnels associés. Ceci a minimalement progressé dans l’intervalle. Petits ostéophytes marginaux. 
Légère tendinose à l’insertion distale du tendon du quadriceps et de façon plus diffuse au niveau du tendon patellaire. Pas de franche déchirure notée. 
Conclusion : 
Nouvelle déchirure radiale transfixiante à la jonction de la corne postérieure et de la racine postérieure de même qu’au niveau de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne avec extrusion secondaire marquée du corps méniscal tel que détaillé ci-haut. Suspicion d’un ossicule méniscal à la jonction de la corne postérieure et de la racine postérieure du ménisque interne, en corrélation avec une radiographie du genou droit. 
Progression dans l’intervalle des changements dégénératifs/chondropathie tricompartimentaux, sévères au compartiment fémoro-tibial interne et modérés à sévères au compartiment patellofémoral plus marqués le long de la facette patellaire externe de l’apex patellaire. 
Petit épanchement intra-articulaire.

In the medial compartment, intactr medial meniscus. There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury.  
 The lateral compartment, there is radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. The articular cartilage appears normal.  
 The patellofemoral joint appears congruent. There is low grade chondrosis at medial patellar facet. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 There is complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. The posterior cruciate ligament is low grade partial tear with buckling. There is anterior tibial translation.  
 The medial and lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Positive knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is no fracture or bone contusion. - Radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. 
 - Complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at proximal (femoral) side  
 - The posterior cruciate ligament is low grade partial tear with buckling

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Moderate joint effusion. No popliteal cyst.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
Normal.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
Normal.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
Complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament. Intact posterior cruciate ligament.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Focal deep chondral fissure of the medial patellar facet without underlying bone marrow reactive changes.

Bones:
Multifocal bone contusions involving the posterolateral tibial plateau and medial femoral condyle.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
None

CONCLUSION:
1.Complete anterior cruciate ligament tear.
2.Multifocal bone contusions involving the posterolateral tibial plateau and medial femoral condyle.
3.Focal grade 3 chondropathy in the medial patellar facet.
4.Moderate joint effusion.

Na seriji MR presjeka lijevog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala kolateralnih
ligamenata, stražnjeg križnog ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa, patelarnog ligamenta i tetive m.
kvadricepsa.
Mukoidna degeneracija prednjeg križnog ligamenta, izraženije pri tibijalnom hvatištu, uz održan
kontinuitet vlakana. Manja cista uz tibijalno hvatište ACL neposredno uz prednji korijen
lateralnog meniska.
Lateralni menisk uredne je morfologije i intenziteta signala.
Intrasupstancijsko povišenjen intenziteta signala stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska - ddg.
degenerativne promjene.
Pliće fissure <50% lateralne fasete patele (hondromalacija II. stupnja). Gotovo je potpuno
reducirana artikulacijske hrskavice medijalne fasete patele.
Centralno između medijalne i lateralne fasete patele vidi se manja zona koštanog edema -
hondromalacija IV. stupnja.
Hondromalacija I. stupnja artikulacijskih hrskavica femorotibijalnog zgloba.
Ne nalazi se poplitealne (Bakerove) ciste. Manja multilokulirana ganglion cista uz femoralno
hvatište stražnjeg križnog ligamenta.
Diskretan supkutani edem prepatelarno i infrapatelarno.
Edem Hoffine masti infrapatelarno - ddg. impigement.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküste grade III dejenerasyon ve posterior hornunda horizontal yırtık ile uyumlu görünüm izlendi. Lateral menisküs normaldir. Medial kollateral ligamen çevresinde periligamentöz ödem izlendi ( grade I sprain ). Ön çapraz bağda mukoid dejenerasyon ile uyumlu sinyal artışı mevcuttur. Ön çapraz bağ tibia yapışma düzeyinde subkondrial milimetrik kistler izlendi.Arka çapraz bağ ve lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Suprapatellar bursada ve infrapatellar bursada diz eklemi içerisinde sıvı artışı izlendi.Tibiofemoral eklem medial düzeyde femoral yüzde 6x3.5 mm ve 5x3 mm boyutlarında, tibial yüzde 6x2 mm boyutlarında osteokondrial defektler ve komşuluklarında kemik iliği ödemleri izlendi. Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapılarda osteofitik sivrileşmeler, tibiofemoral eklem medialde eklem mesafesinde daralma ve komşu kartilajlarda özellikle tibial kartilajda belirgin incelmeler izlenmiştir ( dejeneratif artrit bulguları ). Diz eklemi posteriorda medialde büyüğü yaklaşık 8 mm çapta 2 adet eklem içi cisim izlendi(loose body).
